summary: The paper resolves five fundamental open questions regarding negative partial transpose (NPT) bound entanglement in Werner states by establishing exact Walled Brauer B_{3,1}(d) spectral collapse, proving the sharp d_min = 8 impossibility barrier for lower dimensions d <= 7 via exact rational dual certificates, constructing a closed-form all-d >= 8 NPT bound-entangled Werner family, proving U(d)-equivariant branch uniqueness, and establishing exact white-noise robustness ceilings. The work is fully supported by 20 constructive Lean 4 theorems with zero sorry and zero warnings, 16 AST-audited zero-float exact-rational SHA-256 certificates, and an adversarial test suite.
